So many variables. Depends entirely on risk appetite, asset class, duration, beta

62540729
>>62539626
I would gladly hold 100% of my portfolio in BTC. So when I want to buy an altcoin I simply size my position with it so the altcoin's ATR matches BTC's.

Let's say BTC moves at 3% per day on average while the altcoin I want to buy moves at 12% per day on average. This means the altcoin is 4x more volatile than bitcoin, so I buy 25% of my portfolio of that altcoin. If the alt dumps 12% the day after I bought it then it would only do 3% of damage to my portfolio, same as BTC.

3/12 = 25%

This let's me buy any alt I want and I never buy more than my portfolio can handle
